title: sdr daily scratchpad - Olivia Wong - 2026-03-04
content:
TODAY (2026-03-04) - quick plan and running notes

Morning goals:
- 9:00-10:30 AM: 20 dials (focus on mid-market finance leads)
- 10:30-11:00 AM: follow-up emails for warm replies from last week
- 1:00-2:30 PM: Demo scheduling block (bookings and reschedules)
- Finish 5 salesforce updates and move 3 opps to next step

Top priority accounts to touch (call > email > LinkedIn)
1) BlueBridge Capital - Contact: Mark Lewis (VP Eng) - last touch 2/26 - very interested in latency benchmarks. Goal: schedule 20 min tech intro. Notes: mentioned "cost concerns"; send tailored cost/latency one-pager. SFDC opp 00345.
2) Helios Payments - Contact: Priya Kaur (Head of AI) - demo no-show 3/1 - call to reschedule + ask about Blackout windows.
3) NovaHealth - Contact: Chris J. (CTO) - inbound trial started; needs Dedicated pricing. Action: coordinate with AE Javier for pricing call.
4) ScaleEdge - Contact: Elena Petrov (Platform Lead) - interested in Private deployment; send compliance checklist + request NDA.

Follow-ups (emails to send) - templates below, personalize 1-2 lines
- BlueBridge: "Mark — quick cost and latency note attached. Can we sync 20m this week?"
- Helios: "Priya — sorry we missed you. Are mornings better? Happy to demo specific flow you asked about."
- NovaHealth: "Chris — Javier from our team can do a pricing + architecture walkthrough Tue/Thu. Which works?"

Voicemail script quick (30s):
"Hey [Name], Olivia with Redwood Inference. Quick note — saw your trial and wanted to offer a brief walkthrough of Dedicated pricing and latency options. Give me a ring at 415-555-01xx or reply to the email I sent. Thanks!"

Objections and rebuttals (short):
- "Too expensive" -> "understandable — we also have batching + quantization packs that reduce cost by X% for chat workloads; can run a quick analyze on your token mix and show estimated $/k tokens."
- "We host ourselves" -> "nice — Redwood Private can plug into your VPC, or Dedicated if you prefer reserved capacity; many self-hosted teams switch for SLO + support reasons."

Meeting notes snippets (to paste into SFDC after calls)
- BlueBridge call 2026-03-04: interested in low-latency search use case; will share perf numbers; next: 20m tech sync (target 3/6). Owner: Olivia.
- Helios reschedule: Priya prefers AM; propose 3/5 9am PT. Ask about PCI scope and data residency.

Pipeline hygiene tasks (TODAY):
- Update stage + close dates for 5 opps
- Add call outcomes for yesterday (left VM / connected / follow-up)
- Move stale leads (no reply >90d) to nurture sequence

Open questions / to escalate to AE Javier:
- NovaHealth: confirm Dedicated capacity pricing bands (gpus, burst policy) and any promos this quarter.
- ScaleEdge: legal needs an NDA template and SOC2 summary — who owns? (CS or Legal?)

Personal reminders / micro-tasks:
- Lunch: 12:00 (booked)
- Submit expenses for conference (Feb travel) before EOD Fri
- Update Outreach cadence with new email variant (A/B test subject lines)

Templates / quick copy (copy-paste friendly)
Email subject options:
- "Quick sync on Redwood pricing + latency — 20m?"
- "Redwood: tailored cost estimate for BlueBridge"

Email body (short):
"Hey Mark —

Thanks again for the chat — attaching a short note on expected latency/cost for a 2k token baseline. Would you have 20 minutes this week to walk through?

Best,
Olivia"

Notes-to-self (informal):
- Keep calls high-energy; mention our caching/kv saving when prospect brings up costs
- Always ask "what failure modes keep you up at night?" to surface reliability needs
- Pull latest latency bench PDF from /confluence/perf/latency-2026 before BlueBridge call

End-of-day checklist:
- Log all activities in SFDC + Outreach
- Set next action for each warm lead (call, email, send deck)
- Prep for tomorrow: list 10 new prospects from ZoomInfo for vertical: fintech

Misc scratch (short-hand):
- notes: Mark likes concrete numbers -> bring 95p latency & $/k tokens table
- detour: prod team scheduled release 3/6 might affect demo environment - check with eng channel

-- Olivia
(quick running log; will clean for handoff if needed)
